objective: 基于解析解与数值积分的对比，验证一维非线性薛定谔方程（NLSE）孤子解在色散与非线性平衡下的稳定性，误差容限<1e-6，10轮迭代内收敛。 假设：在适当初始条件下，数值模拟的NLSE孤子应保持形状不变且能量、动量守恒，与解析解偏差随时间增长不超过1e-6。 成功判据：数值解与解析解在t=10时的L2范数误差 < 1e-6；能量守恒相对误差 < 1e-8，动量守恒相对误差 < 1e-7 独立校验：使用已知解析解（如sech²形式）作为初始条件，通过有限差分法求解NLSE，对比数值解与解析解在多个时间点的波形与守恒量。

input_params.description: Implement a minimal 1D NLSE solver testbed that isolates the discrete Noether-drift mechanism. (1) Correct the initial condition to the true NLSE soliton ψ(x,0)=A·sech(Bx)·exp(i·vx/2) with A=B=1 (standard normalized NLSE iψ_t + ½ψ_xx + |ψ|²ψ=0), on a periodic domain large enough that boundary effects are negligible; explicitly reject sech² (KdV-type) as flagged by blind spot 1. (2) Implement three integrators sharing the same spatial grid: (a) Strang split-step Fourier (SSFM) — symplectic, structure-preserving; (b) 4th-order central difference in space + explicit RK4 in time — non-symplectic; (c) Crank-Nicolson in time with 4th-order central space, solved by fixed-point iteration (to measure the "10 iterations" convergence criterion). (3) Construct discrete Noether charges: N_h = Σ|ψ_j|²Δx (phase-translation charge) and P_h = Im Σ ψ̄_j (ψ_{j+1}−ψ_{j-1})/(2Δx)·Δx (space-translation charge), and record their relative drift dN/dt, dP/dt at each output time — this is the direct measurement of "discrete Noether drift." (4) Run all three to t=10 at matched Δt (start Δt=1e-3, refine to 1e-4), record L2 error vs exact soliton at t=0,2,5,10, and the charge drift time series. (5) Grid-refinement study (N=512,1024,2048) to confirm spatial convergence and rule out resolution artifacts. (6) Cross-check: compare SSFM L2 error against the analytic solution independently of the other schemes; verify that at matched Δt, SSFM's L2 error and charge drift are orders of magnitude smaller than RK4's — that asymmetry is the signature that Noether drift, not truncation error, dominates. Also verify energy rel.err < 1e-8 and momentum rel.err < 1e-7 criteria. Note: the "10 iterations to converge" criterion is only meaningful for the nonlinear CN fixed-point; report its iteration count and show it is decoupled from the drift mechanism (i.e., convergence of the inner loop does not eliminate secular drift if the scheme is non-symplectic).
input_params.expected_prediction: With the correct sech initial condition and SSFM at Δt=1e-4, N=1024, the L2 error at t=10 will be ≲1e-9 and the discrete Noether charge drift will be bounded (non-secular, oscillatory, amplitude ~1e-12), satisfying both the L2<1e-6 and energy rel.err<1e-8 criteria. With explicit RK4 at the same Δt, the L2 error at t=10 will exceed 1e-4 with secular linear-in-t growth in dN/dt and dP/dt (drift rate ~O(Δt^4) local but accumulated linearly), failing the criteria — confirming that discrete Noether drift, not local truncation, is the dominant error mechanism. The CN fixed-point will converge within 10 iterations but still show secular charge drift, decoupling inner-loop convergence from long-time fidelity.
